4_pitfalls_already_hit: pre-registration must precede the candidate: the gate compares the candidate start with the registered_at and refuses the reversed order (exit 2).
promotion needs the full five declared months: a subset is reported as 'days outside declared periods' and can only be evidence-insufficient.
5bp is a stress gate only: every current model breaks even at 2.23-2.40bp, so 5bp net returns are negative; never relax 5bp, lower a threshold or pick a scenario after seeing results.

the official turnover item is a cross-submission rank percentile and cannot be computed locally; local U/2=1.10195 is monotone directional evidence only, identical across the four cost scenarios, and must not be converted into a percentile.
seed count and same-day stocks are not independent date evidence: compare paired trading days with 5-day consecutive blocks inside disjoint periods.
candidate artifacts must be eval-v2: either metrics.json with metrics_0bp/metrics_5bp plus daily_0bp.csv/daily_5bp.csv, or a run dir with predictions/targets that the gate re-evaluates.
a scope patch may only narrow applicability: any patch that moves a number or widens the gate is refused, and it never supplies the ordering timestamp.

scope_patches.direction: narrowing a mis-specified applicability, not relaxing a quality threshold
must_not: be treated as a threshold registration or as a registration timestamp for the 'candidate must start after registration' check
extend the gate to training memory or drop the inference limit
change any number while claiming a scope-only revision
scope_patches.reason: 24 GiB is the platform notebook/submission limit. Training runs on the 60 GB cloud host and is not bounded by it, so the registered applies_to wrongly gated the training run as well: a candidate whose training peak is legal against 24576 MiB but above the 20889 MiB promotion line would have been rejected for a limit that does not apply to training. Only the applicability of the limit changes; the limit, the headroom and every quality threshold stay as registered.
